title: Saul Looks for Donkeys
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who looks and looks, and tonight Saul searches for lost donkeys and finds the prophet instead: Scout hunts for a lost library book and finds a lonely new neighbor.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Saul spent days searching, and searching is what Scout does best. In Scout’s world today: his library book is lost, and Mom says he has to find it before school. Scout looks under the bed, behind the couch, and all the way out to the backyard fort. No book. But by the fence he finds a new boy from next door, sitting all alone. Scout says hi, and they play until dinner. The book turns up later in the car. Just like Saul looking for donkeys, Scout learned that Heavenly Father can use a plain, everyday job to lead you somewhere good.
